method: Agent visual review of four Inkscape-rendered contact pages, native SVG geometry comparison and original XML membership/layers, before any train/held-out split.
rows: Flybook engraving: separate letter Paths and rigid letter/frame Groups. Two hidden output-off cut outlines remain fixed; the larger hidden outline is absent from native SVG. Scan artwork is not labelled as cut holes.
Blue sword artwork is one Group, Rouge is a separate Text proxy. Disabled outer ellipse remains fixed.
Three disabled red rectangles. Blank native render is expected; dimensions and fixed membership are read from XML and hidden SVG rectangles.
One outer cut rectangle encloses all test circles and annotations; they travel together.
Outer rounded rectangle plus four separate cut swatches. Engraved swatches and labels attach to the surrounding outline; T1 stays fixed.
Backup has only its outer rounded rectangle enabled. Twenty-one disabled/tool objects remain fixed.

Dice tray has four visible slotted walls and a base, but original top-level membership is eleven units. Only two walls have their three slots grouped; standalone slot rectangles remain separate by the plan's rule.
D20 artwork Group and Mighty Fine Text move separately; disabled six-sided Polygon stays fixed.
Four winged word Groups have three internal cut holes each; isolated word Group has one. The long outer rectangle is a separate top-level cutting unit.
Backup has four winged words and eleven ordinary word Groups; two disabled rectangles remain fixed.
Keychain template is one Group entirely on output-off layers; no movable units.
Duck and vehicle Groups move. Three disabled rectangles and the mixed bee/disabled-outline Group stay fixed; keeping that entire rigid Group fixed satisfies both preservation rules.
One blue rectangular cut jig plus fixed T1 rectangle.
Printable-area jig is only a T1 rectangle; no movable units.
Keychain outer Path carries the two contained Text objects. Three separate top-level cut circles remain separate; disabled rectangle is fixed.
Tree silhouette is stored as 37 separate closed top-level Paths including both circular frames. Interior cut islands are separate units under the specified top-level rule.
Wi-Fi, flip-me-over and Scan-for-WiFi are three engraving units. Tool and disabled rectangles remain fixed.

Grid has 32 axis-aligned open Paths, five circles and 50 Text objects. Fourteen contained labels attach to the smallest enclosing circle. Thirty-two exact bounds are degenerate: warn and require grouping or an explicit nonzero proxy before nesting; never silently drop them.
One image is enabled; two other images and the card outline are output-off. Image rectangles, including fixed images, match native SVG corners.
Two independent image rectangles, Android and person, with distinct Image settings.
Keyboard experiment contains 138 top-level objects. Enabled test rectangles attach their enclosed labels; an additional image remains separate. A hundred output-off objects stay fixed.

Keycap test retains separate rigid annotation Groups, twelve rounded cut outlines, four circles and the frame. The ungrouped title attaches to the smallest enclosing outline; rigid Groups are never swallowed by another unit.
Multiline address is one Text proxy. Original lacks BackupPath; native re-save supplies reference outlines only, without modifying the original.
Twenty-eight image tests, one enabled. Original Image settings, rather than vector settings sharing the same numeric index, control fixed membership.
Open hand-outline Group is one rigid unit; its disabled counterpart remains fixed. Open cut strokes are retained as group content, not fabricated closed contours.
Twenty-eight switch rectangles plus an outer rectangle are all separate top-level units; their apparent plate relationship is not an XML group.
Icon template has six enabled image rectangles and 51 fixed objects. Image-setting family is read independently of the vector family.
Template variant has one enabled vector rectangle; 53 objects remain fixed, including the text and images.
Malformed Bezier primitive lacks control points. Published converter and native exporter both produce the same diagonal line; preserve a clear fallback warning and use its rectangle proxy.
Butterfly contour is one rigid Group with one exterior and no internal cut holes.
Single circle: one exterior, no holes.
Four separate rounded crosses, three blue and one red, each closed with no holes.
Original and native re-save contain no Shape elements; native SVG export is zero bytes. The render is explicitly the independent converter's empty-project diagnostic, not source geometry.
One square in a single-child Group; no holes.
Embedded grid bitmap is a single rectangle proxy; all four corners agree with native export.
K Text attaches to its containing keychain outer Path. The small top-level ellipse stays a separate cutting unit.
One diagonal open line has a non-degenerate rectangular proxy, no cut holes.
Ring construction retains ten top-level units including open-score proxies. Two grouped profiles each contain one rectangular opening.
One word Text with BackupPath. Native reports unavailable Sans Serif; original backup and native SVG geometry still agree exactly in bounds.
Ten closed colour-wheel sectors on Scan layers are ten outline units, no holes.
Legacy test contains 28 Scan+Cut rectangles and 15 Text proxies. Original layer modes are authoritative; native 2.1.01 re-save changes Scan+Cut to Scan and is reference geometry only.
Legacy scan test contains 28 closed swatches and 15 Text proxies. Missing text caches are recorded; native-generated text outlines are reference evidence only.
